szoveg_eredeti:
Today, it is more important than ever to fight for a future where AI is not controlled by just two companies.

On this day we release the v1.0.0 of the Llama.cpp libraries.

The foundation is now stable for the thousands of applications built on top of Llama.cpp and the millions of developers building them.

As local AI, privacy and sovereignty will become increasingly important in our everyday lives, we reiterate our commitment to covering every platform and every model type out there, while keeping the library robust and lean.

Kudos to Georgi Gerganov , Merve Noyan and team 🖤
